central_question: Where should AI inference state live when active generation alternates with paused tool calls?
claims_and_limits: The vendor describes NVFP4, model distribution, routing and KV-cache tiers spanning GPU, CPU and shared storage.
NVIDIA's up to 30x throughput-per-dollar result compares Vera Rubin NVL72 with GB300 NVL72 on AgentX DeepSeek V4 Pro at 125 tokens per second per user.
Per-dollar and per-megawatt comparisons use distinct denominators; neither establishes arbitrary-model acceleration or return on investment.
